title: MoSAIC: Scalable Probabilistic Error Cancellation via Variational Blockwise Noise Aggregation
summary: Quantum error mitigation is essential for extracting trustworthy results from noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) processors. Yet, current approaches face a core scalability bottleneck: unbiased methods such as probabilistic error cancellation (PEC) incur exponential sampling overhead, while approximate techniques like zero-noise extrapolation trade accuracy for efficiency.
